kwargs.prompt: how are we using all this metadata? /talk
kwargs.thinking: Mapped consumers: ranker (genre/mood/meta_score), TagEmbedder, MetadataEncoder 512d (sidecar JSON only), MetaClipper text, FoldInjector, PhiLibrary.by_genre, consensus BPM, dataset export. Dual store is the real issue.
kwargs.outcome: Talk: metadata is used in layers, not uniformly. Ranker uses Spotify valence/energy + Last.fm/MB tags. 512-d encoder still only sees sidecar JSON (key, duration, lfm). Dual store (JSON vs meta.db) is the gap. Recommended treating annotations as single source before filling reserved encoder dims.
